market_summary: Late New York session trading is characterized by broad consolidation across asset classes after earlier volatility. FX pairs, precious metals, and BTCUSD are consolidating below their respective session VWAP and EMA50 levels with subdued RVOL and neutral-to-bearish CVD. US100 remains elevated above VWAP and EMA50 but is capped below its Gamma Flip and Put Wall #1 in a negative amplifying GEX regime. With all assets resting mid-channel or at session fair value without expansion catalysts, all setups warrant HOLD.

With no breakout volume and immediate Call Wall resistance, setup is HOLD.
